text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":1,"unit":"badge","kind":"count","span":"earns 1 girl scout badge every month"},{"id":"q2","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"twice as long to earn a badge"},{"id":"q3","value":3,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"three times the amount of badges"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"Claire's monthly badge rate divided by 2 (Amber takes twice as long) gives Amber's monthly badge rate"},{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q3"],"out":"s2","note":"Claire's monthly badge rate times 3 gives Wendy's monthly badge rate"},{"op":"sub","args":["s2","s1"],"out":"s3","note":"Wendy's monthly rate minus Amber's monthly rate gives the monthly difference in badges earned"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"how many more badges Wendy earns than Amber over a 1-year time frame (the monthly difference scaled to a year)"},"dismissed":[{"value":1,"reason":"the '1' in '1 year time frame' sets the duration in words; converting it to a number of months requires outside knowledge not given as a number in the text"}]}
